answer: In PoA, every identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, while attestations are linked by provenance and timing. If k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting states, correlated slashing grows quadratically, O(k^2), exhausting their escrows rather than pricing faults independently. Detection also triggers asymmetric capital depreciation and an exponential multiplier in capital loss for the controlling principal, making any sybil swarm economically ruinous; walnut, plume, and juniper identities provide no evasion benefit.
